skill.summary: Speech-to-text via SkillBoss API Hub (STT, powered by Whisper and more).

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of speech-to-text skill powered by Whisper and other models via SkillBoss API Hub.
- Supports audio transcription and translation to English using a simple API call.
- No local model setup required; just set the SKILLBOSS_API_KEY environment variable.
- Includes Python quick start guide for immediate use.
- Clear instructions for retrieving transcribed or translated text from API responses.
